findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "environmental-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: environmental-intelligence_carbon-report-consistency-check, environmental-intelligence_permit-expiry-check, environmental-intelligence_evidence-report · Private data: environmental-intelligence_carbon-emission-factor-normalize, environmental-intelligence_evidence-report · Public sink: environmental-intelligence_carbon-emission-factor-normalize, environmental-intelligence_scope-1-emissions-calculate, environmental-intelligence_scope-2-emissions-calculate, environmental-intelligence_scope-3-supplier-data-validate, environmental-intelligence_carbon-report-consistency-check, environmental-intelligence_water-consumption-anomaly-detect, environmental-intelligence_water-intensity-calculate, environmental-intelligence_permit-expiry-check, environmental-intelligence_waste-manifest-reconcile, environmental-intelligence_evidence-report · Destructive: environmental-intelligence_carbon-emission-factor-normalize, environmental-intelligence_scope-1-emissions-calculate, environmental-intelligence_scope-2-emissions-calculate, environmental-intelligence_scope-3-supplier-data-validate, environmental-intelligence_carbon-report-consistency-check, environmental-intelligence_water-consumption-anomaly-detect, environmental-intelligence_water-intensity-calculate, environmental-intelligence_permit-expiry-check, environmental-intelligence_waste-manifest-reconcile, environmental-intelligence_evidence-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
